title: Find orders without customers
task: Write a left join that finds orphan orders. Check it with one matched row and one missing customer.

title: Rank monthly sales
task: Partition sales by store and rank each month by revenue. Decide how tied months should appear.

title: Read a query plan
task: Compare a query plan before and after indexing a lookup column. Explain the change in scan strategy.

title: Undo a partial transfer
task: Model a transfer across two accounts and roll back a failed debit. Verify both balances.

title: Isolate a payment service
task: Replace a payment gateway with a mock. Assert that a rejected payment leaves the order pending.

title: Test a date boundary
task: Write tests for a date range that crosses midnight. Include the first and last valid instant.

title: Design a retryable endpoint
task: Sketch an order endpoint that accepts a retry key. Demonstrate two requests producing one order.

title: Restart a file import
task: Record progress after each batch and simulate a restart. Check the output for duplicate records.

title: Label a confusing form
task: Rewrite three form labels so each identifies the requested input. Add an example beside an ambiguous field.

title: Trace keyboard focus
task: Navigate a form with the keyboard. Record the focus order and repair one unreachable control.

title: Choose a comparison chart
task: Plot the same sales totals as bars and a line. Explain which chart supports comparing stores.

title: Repair a misleading axis
task: Redraw a bar chart with a zero baseline. Describe how the visual claim changes.
